note: Shot list for «الضفدع هرب… وأنت؟». Each shot starts on a spoken word of the measured take (anchor: segment, word, n-th match, offset s) and ends where the next starts. Acting notes give the beginning pose → anticipation → main action → follow-through → settle.

shots.narration: يقولون: الضفدع ما ينتبه للخطر إذا جاه بالتدريج…
shots.scene_goal: Hook in motion from frame 0; set up the myth
shots.action: Begin: frog on a red swim ring, eyes on a buzzing fly. Anticipation: eyes lock. Action: the tongue snaps the fly (frames 2–10). Follow-through: gulp, throat bounce, happy eyes. Settle: lounges, arms behind its head, while the red thermometer creeps up on «بالتدريج»
Begin: half-lidded, lounging. Action on «تدري»: eyes snap to the thermometer and go wide, brows up, arms drop. Follow-through: throat puffs twice. The red jumps a notch

shots.scene_goal: The correction, acted: frogs try to escape
shots.action: Anticipation: a slow deep crouch, determined brows. Action on «يهرب»: full stretch leap, arms flung up, splash drops. Landing on the dry rock: squash 0.9 → overshoot → settle. Follow-through: relieved grin, a wave. The empty ring floats on
shots.camera: Medium wide, follows the arc; 5 px landing shake
shots.visual_punchline: The frog is smarter than the story

shots.narration: يعني القصة مو صحيحة… هي مجرد تشبيه.
shots.action: On «مو» he scratches his head, embarrassed; the frog (towel on) hops onto his desk and nods, smug. On «تشبيه» open palms, relieved; the pill «القصة مجرد تشبيه» lands
Open palms → points at the viewer on «علينا»; the frog raises an arm too

shots.scene_goal: Match cut: the frog's thermometer becomes his screen-time bar
shots.action: The red thermometer swings flat and shrinks into the bar above his phone; he lounges on a bean bag, thumb flicking; «5 دقائق»; the feed starts to spill out as a conveyor
«10 دقائق»; the conveyor of cards lengthens and speeds up; he leans in, eyes glued
shots.visual_punchline: The feed becomes a factory belt

shots.action: The belt races, the wall clock spins, the window goes dark; «60 دقيقة» on «ساعة»; he snaps upright, eyes to the clock, then embarrassed
Weighs a task sheet (curious) → anticipation: arm back → flicks it onto the desk pile (smug); a «بكرة» calendar sheet drops on top on «لبكرة»; he waves it off
«بكرة» sheets keep raining onto the pile; on «كومة» it topples (anticipation: he looks up, arms rise) and buries him to the chest — face clear, embarrassed

shots.narration: ما تغيّر شي في يوم واحد… تغيّر شوي، ثم شوي.
shots.scene_goal: Gradual normalisation, the frog metaphor's real meaning
shots.action: He's back on the phone inside the heap, content. On each «شوي» the heap, the clock and the wall thermometer move one notch; the camera steps in with them; he never looks up
shots.visual_punchline: The thermometer from the pond is on his wall

shots.action: Deadpan stare, then a slow sideways point at the lost hour (no words). On «اسأل نفسك» he turns to us and taps his temple

shots.narration: وش الشي اللي صار عادي عندي… وهو قبل كان يزعجني؟
shots.scene_goal: The tool: notice what became normal
shots.action: He stops scrolling; eyes go down to the heap, up to the clock, over to the window (a «؟» bubble on «عادي»); the frog appears outside and taps the glass on «قبل»; on «يزعجني» surprise → embarrassment
Anticipation: thumb to the side button; on «اليوم» the screen goes dark; he lays the phone face down on the heap; determined
Leans in and pulls ONE sheet out of the heap; writes; ticks it on «صغيرة»; follow-through: holds it up, laughs; settle: shoulders drop with relief; the heap is one sheet lower
Outside his lit window the frog (dry, towel on) watches him hold up the finished sheet; a proud hop on «هرب»; on «وأنت؟» it turns to us and points; the card «الضفدع هرب… وأنت؟» lands

shots.narration: لا تنتظر المشكلة تكبر عشان تنتبه.
shots.scene_goal: The line to remember; out fast
shots.action: Slow pull-out; inside he waves his sheet; the frog waves back, winks; «لا تنتظر المشكلة تكبر» joins the card on «تكبر»; ends 1.8 s after the last word
